definition: Novelty of the sequence against NCBI GenBank, from BLAST percent identity to the closest described organism. known >=98%; divergent 95-98%; putative_novel <95%; unassessed where no BLAST was run.
positive_example: A 16S sequence at 91.2% identity to its nearest neighbour -> putative_novel
negative_example: A sequence at 99.4% identity labelled putative_novel because the taxon is locally unfamiliar. Local unfamiliarity is not novelty.
review_method: 10% human audit; any putative_novel call reviewed by a second bioinformatician

definition: Predicted protein or gene-cluster function from a structure or sequence model. Always recorded with the model and version that produced it.
positive_example: 'non-ribosomal peptide synthetase (predicted)' from an antiSMASH cluster call
negative_example: 'antibiotic' — a claim about activity, not a prediction about function. Activity requires wet-lab assay.

definition: Model-estimated relevance of the sequence to one of the four declared disease targets. A prioritisation score for wet-lab triage, not a prediction of efficacy.
positive_example: 0.81 for a BGC-dense actinomycete metagenome against AMR targets
negative_example: Reporting 0.81 as an 81% chance the compound works. It is a ranking aid.
review_method: distribution reviewed per batch; not used as a sole basis for any claim

definition: Confidence in the annotation itself, distinct from confidence in the underlying measurement.
negative_example: Leaving it blank because the annotation is a guess. A low score is information; a null is not.
review_method: audited alongside the label it qualifies

definition: Putative activity class of the annotated compound, inferred from spectral library match and published activity of the matched compound. Never from the traditional indication alone.
positive_example: Quercetin -> anti-inflammatory, from a level 1 library match and published activity
negative_example: Assigning anti-parasitic because a holder described an anti-parasitic use. That would launder the heritage record into a chemical claim and destroy the independence of the two streams.
assigned_by: human annotator with pharmaceutical chemistry background
review_method: double annotation on all non-unknown assignments; disagreement escalated to adjudication

definition: Metabolomics Standards Initiative identification confidence. 1 confirmed against an authentic standard; 2 putative from spectral library; 3 putative class only; 4 unknown.
positive_example: Chlorogenic acid at 0.98 library match with a matching InChIKey -> level 1
negative_example: Calling a level 3 feature by a specific compound name in a report. Level 3 supports a class, not a name.
review_method: every level 1 claim independently verified before release

definition: Novelty of the compound against external natural-product databases.
positive_example: An unmatched formula with no database hit -> putative_novel
negative_example: Marking novel because it is absent from one library. Absence from a Western-biased library is the expected case here, not evidence.
review_method: second reviewer on all novel calls

definition: Denormalised foreign key to the heritage record that directed collection of the parent sample. Present so label joins do not require a three-table hop.
positive_example: ZW-TK-2026-001 on a sequence from a knowledge-led sample
negative_example: Populating it from geographic proximity. The link means 'this knowledge caused this collection', not 'these were near each other'.
review_method: validator checks it matches the parent sample's heritage_use_ref

definition: Whether the English rendering of a verbatim vernacular record has been checked by a bilingual reviewer. The vernacular text is the scientific object; the translation is a derivative.
positive_example: human_verified after a second Shona-speaking reviewer confirms the rendering
negative_example: Releasing a machine_draft record. Records below human_verified are held out of every tier.
review_method: second bilingual reviewer; disagreements resolved with the holder where possible

definition: How a taxonomic identification was established. A label-noise indicator for any model trained on species labels.
positive_example: A specimen matched to a National Herbarium accession -> herbarium_confirmed
negative_example: Upgrading to herbarium_confirmed because the field team was confident.
assigned_by: field team, then National Herbarium, then sequencing
review_method: field_tentative records down-weighted in training and flagged in any release
